prompt: Which query returns, for the users who signed up from January to March 2025, the number of users of each signup month with a payment that was not refunded, in each month offset? The cohort month is the UTC month of signup_ts; the offset counts calendar months from it to the UTC month of paid_at, 0 for the signup month. One row per cohort month and offset with at least one paying user, in the columns cohort_month, month_offset and paying_users.

options.text:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       date_diff('month', date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts), date_trunc('month', p.paid_at)) AS month_offset,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM signups u
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE NOT p.refunded
  AND u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       date_diff('day', u.signup_ts, p.paid_at) // 30 AS month_offset,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM signups u
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE NOT p.refunded
  AND u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1, 2

WITH first_pay AS (  -- one row per user who has paid
  SELECT s.user_id, MIN(p.paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  GROUP BY s.user_id
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', f.first_paid_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       date_diff('month', date_trunc('month', f.first_paid_at), date_trunc('month', p.paid_at)) AS month_offset,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM first_pay f
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = f.user_id
JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE NOT p.refunded
  AND f.first_paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND f.first_paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       date_diff('month', date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts), date_trunc('month', p.paid_at)) AS month_offset,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM signups u
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1, 2
